title: Collaborative Robot (Cobot) Actuator Housings
description: Thin-wall complex housings with integrated bearing journals, precision gear mounting features, sealing surfaces, and connector ports
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) provides 45% weight saving vs steel and 2x the strength of 6061-T6 aluminum, enabling lighter cobot arms with higher payload capacity and better safety.
Form: Bar stock for small actuator housings (<100mm dia). Forged blanks for larger housings requiring enhanced mechanical properties.
engineeringTrends: Process: CNC turning & milling of housing
Process: Precision boring of bearing journals
Process: Thread milling of connector ports
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B348 Grade 5, STA condition, 100% dimensional + concentricity inspection, anodized finish
